cohort: 638 women who gave birth at a Brazilian tertiary maternity between 2008 and 2012
finding: While FSFI scores were similar between women who experienced SMM and those who didn't, SMM was associated with a longer delay to resume sexual activity postpartum.
mod_finding: Women who experienced severe maternal morbidity had statistically significant differences in rates of cesarean section compared to women who had uncomplicated pregnancies.
